description: Pure bending of a rectangular curved bar, Q4 plane-stress continuum, verified against the exact Airy elasticity solution; Winkler-Bach deviation quantified

loading.sign_convention: positive = hoop tension at the bore

anchors.description: The reference itself satisfies radial equilibrium, both traction-free cylindrical surfaces, the prescribed moment and its own strain-displacement relation; all residuals at round-off
Neutral-axis radius recovered from the discrete hoop stress on the symmetry ray against r_n = h/ln(r_o/r_i); relative error < 1 %
sigma_theta at element centres vs exact; L2 and worst point (normalised by max|sigma_theta|) < 3 %
sigma_r at element centres vs exact; L2 and worst point (normalised by max|sigma_theta|) < 3 %
Nodal u_x on the symmetry ray vs exact; worst and L2 relative error < 3 %
Internal moment w*int sigma_theta (r_bar - r) dr rebuilt from the discrete field on the symmetry ray equals the applied M to < 1 %; net axial force is nil

Exactly zero shear in the reference; the discrete max|tau_rtheta|/max|sigma_theta| must stay below 1 %. Its observed order is reported separately because the parasitic shear of curved bilinear elements is only O(h), not O(h^2)
The rigid x-translation gauge of the polar model is pinned to the exact value and, independently, to zero; the interior stress field must agree to < 1e-6 of the hoop scale

Observed order of the hoop L2, radial L2 and displacement errors between the two finest meshes >= 1.5 (the O(h^2) family, allowing pre-asymptotic scatter); the O(h) parasitic shear is gated by `shear_free_state`, not here
Radial grading towards the bore must not degrade the certified errors at equal degrees of freedom; reported, not gated on a single rung
